decisionChannel: Repository owner answers given interactively in the orchestrator Claude Code chat on 2026-11-12 to the decision packet specs/049-harness-evaluation-learning/t005-unblock-packet-20261112.md. The wording below is a paraphrase of those chat answers, not a quotation.

decisions.detail: Construct harness_verification.Unit objects for the six lineage-assigned cases: L1-C01-a, L1-C02-a, L1-C03-a, L1-C03-b, L1-C03-c (holdout) and L2-C01-a (discovery), in new files, with their hashes frozen in a new freeze record before any run.
L3-C02-a stays unassigned and is not in the cohort. No Unit is built for it.
Arm C is the keep-base outcome of a recorded round, labelled a plumbing control. C equals A by construction, carries no information about refinement, and arm D (library ablation) is not run.

Authorize exactly one offline deterministic cohort run with the R13 guidance double as solver, additional cash EUR 0, cohort label synthetic, outcomes labelled synthetic-control. The run may happen only after the R11 units and the R8 keep-base round are frozen.

runAuthorization.scope: exactly one offline deterministic cohort run of the registered SPEC-049/T005 cohort
runAuthorization.label: synthetic-control
runAuthorization.claims: plumbing only: registration, observation, commitment, grading, denominators and cost reporting connect end to end; every comparison is descriptive-only under D3; no guidance utility, refinement, library, inferential, economic or promotion claim
preconditions: R8 keep-base round frozen in the same record
Run evidence repeats the synthetic-control label

limits: Executes nothing itself. The scoped runAuthorization above is the only permission granted; executionAuthorization stays false for every other purpose. The native cohort (SPEC-049/T004, SPEC-048/T008), arm D and any host, model or paid route stay out of scope. Any change to a frozen value needs a new decision record before outcomes. Recorded by an agent from owner chat answers; it is not independent review.
